item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】FLAC - D-A-D + Stargazer @ Trondheim, Norway 2024-10-22 (audience recording)
item.description:
Just a formality as I put up untracked version when I got home. This replaces that.

Hidden Content:
You must either reply or click 'Like' to see the hidden information contained here.


Rather than chase bands all over Europe I decided to just stay a few days in Trondheim and lucky for me, D-A-D's 40th anniversary tour was in town. I got lost finding the venue so didn't get there til 7:50pm. And walked all the way up to the ticket takers, and asked where I could get tickets. "Ticketmaster online only" Uh oh. No Wi-Fi and I never got a local SIM card. The bouncer up front tells me he is trying to find someone to help me.

Meanwhile I just go into my usual routine asking people rolling up if they have an extra ticket, holding cash in my hand to compensate for any possible language barrier. Security guard laughs and says you won't find a ticket that way.

Maybe 30th person walking by says my friend is coming and yells out "Hey I found a guy." Friend comes up and charges me 400NOK which is face minus service fee. THIS WORKS EVERYWHERE. OK, maybe not North Korea but I have done it now in Finland and Norway in addition to multiple US cities. Tickets are always my last detail.

Anyway the venue was a big concrete warehouse but the walls and ceilings were covered in acoustic panel. Venue was just shy of 2,000 capacity. It was full, I stood real close to the left stack but can't really estimate how full. Show was loud. Band was great, they played 108 minutes. Of course my favorite part is Stig Pedersen's various custom bass guitars.

Stargazer I came in during 1st or 2nd song, ridiculously retro and very entertaining. Great vocalist.

Folder includes a bunch of pictures.

Trondheim itself is a great city. Went to several museums while I was there. Stayed at the Chesterfield Hotel which has the best breakfast buffet ever, included in the $100 per night room.

Just a formality, took almost a year to listen thru this a track at a time. Thanks to the previous posters which made it easy to follow along for track splits but I seem to have found a partial song not listed and separated that from the others. This replaces original raw source posted the day after the show.

Original notes:

Heard all about the cheap tickets tho I don't think I ever heard a Beyonce song. Paid $30 outside.

Lots of ladies in tight jeans and cowboy hats to only be worn once

Got the idea of maybe buying some and returning to sell at the next show. Got a free one.

The show was alright but a bit too long, Doubt I will ever listen again. Do what you want with it.

If I include in a future episode it gets maybe 60 seconds and a few samples

I fell asleep on E line and woke up deep inside of East LA by the 710. Return train stopped running and of course being a cheap date I wouldn't consider ride share. Had to walk a few blocks to find an all night bus then walk around downtown since there was construction by my usual stop
